dimensions.detail: Pages discovered; pages with forms that have tests; pages whose form tests have run.
Forms discovered; with generated tests; with executed tests.
Fields discovered; with at least one test; whose tests have run.
Rules observable from the page (required, format, pattern, step, cross-field), plus rules that could not be tested.
Declared boundaries tested; 18 boundary(ies) unknown because no limit is declared, and none was invented.
Endpoints observed in discovery or as form targets; correlated with a form; exercised by a run.
Categories selected; with generated tests; with executed tests.
Viewports configured: desktop 1440x900, laptop 1280x800, tablet 768x1024, mobile 390x844.
Per-form security checks (reflection, anti-forgery, password handling).
Automated rules, error association, keyboard order and keyboard submission. Human checks are separate.
Form and application states the tests drive through.
Recorded journeys; workflow tests generated and run.

gaps.reason: End-to-end workflows are taken from recorded journeys. They are not inferred from discovery, because the order of real business steps is not visible in the page.
